title: Nothing left at the root
literal_meaning: To wipe out at the root.
explanation: This is an expression for complete destruction, not merely a setback or a surface change. The source pairs it with another expression and explicitly glosses both as destroying something entirely. The root image makes the degree of loss clear: what might have allowed it to continue has also been removed.
meaning_odia: ଏଠାରେ କେବଳ ଉପରୁ କିଛି ନଷ୍ଟ ହେବାର କଥା ନୁହେଁ। ମୂଳ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସବୁ ପୋଛିଦେବାର ଛବିରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଧ୍ୱଂସର ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଉତ୍ସ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏହି ଅର୍ଥ ଦେଇଛି। ଆଉ କିଛି ଅବଶିଷ୍ଟ ନ ରହିବାର ତୀବ୍ରତାକୁ ଏହା ପ୍ରକାଶ କରେ।
usage_example: A flood has destroyed a family’s stored seed, tools and the shed itself; a neighbour uses the expression to describe the extent of the loss. (Original imagined occasion, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Selected as the second expression in the source’s slash-separated pair ଖୋଳ କରିବା/ମୂଳପୋଛ କରିବା. The source’s first term is retained as a related expression, not silently translated through a guessed literal sense or counted as a second entry.
odia_summary: ସାମାନ୍ୟ କ୍ଷତି ନୁହେଁ, ସମୂଳେ ଧ୍ୱଂସ ହେବାର ତୀବ୍ର ଅର୍ଥ।
english_summary: An emphatic expression for destruction that leaves nothing at the root.
